# HierarchyOfApproximations

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A layered framework of progressively simplified models that capture essential brain dynamics at different levels of fidelity. Enables scalable design of neuromorphic hardware by allowing TCC/iNEST implementations to trade off computational cost against biological realism.
